title: SkillEffect: Checked Lowering for Memory-Bounded Agent Tools
abstract: arXiv:2608.17007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent Skills can specify procedural and resource obligations for tool use, and language models instantiate them as concrete programs. However, when models turn this guidance into code for existing tool interfaces, even a semantically correct program may load an entire input and exceed the memory available to one tool call. We present SkillEffect, a checked-lowering runtime for computations with a recoverable source relation, an audited bounded implementation, and a registered output postcondition. Before granting execution authority, an independent checker rebuilds each proposed lowering from the submitted program and immutable input. Every relation plugin supplies a source recognizer, input-fact extractor, bounded-IR constructor, arena-bound function, and postcondition; one common runtime provides checked selection, bounded-VM execution, atomic capacity leasing, and staged publication. translated_title: SkillEffect：内存受限智能体工具的检查式降级
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17007v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体技能可以指定工具使用的程序和资源义务，语言模型将其实例化为具体程序。然而，当模型将这些指导转化为现有工具接口的代码时，即使语义正确的程序也可能加载整个输入并超出单次工具调用的可用内存。我们提出了SkillEffect，这是一个用于具有可恢复源关系、审计有界实现和注册输出后置条件的计算的检查式降级运行时。在授予执行权限之前，一个独立的检查器从提交的程序和不可变输入重建每个提议的降级。每个关系插件提供一个源识别器、输入事实提取器、有界中间表示构造器、竞技场边界函数和后置条件；一个通用运行时提供检查选择、有界虚拟机执行、原子容量租用和分阶段发布。SkillEffect的通用性是架构性的，而非其他。
tldr: SkillEffect 提出了一种检查式降级运行时，通过独立验证和资源边界管理，确保智能体工具在执行前满足内存约束，防止超限加载。
en_tdlr: SkillEffect introduces a checked-lowering runtime that independently validates and bounds resource usage before tool execution, preventing memory overflows in agent tools.
